name: zip_data
label: Zip file data
help: A zip of up to 55 MB holding the images, PDFs, or MP4/MOV videos to watermark. Make's Archive module can create it.

name: items
label: Items (JSON array)
help: One entry for every file in the zip, with its exact path in the zip and nonempty reference data, up to 100. For example [{"filename":"contracts/acme.pdf","data":{"recipient":"acme"}}].

name: idempotency_key
label: Idempotency key
help: Map a stable source event ID. Reuse the same value on retry to get the same batch back.

name: results_archive
label: Zip the results
help: Also zip every watermarked file into one download when the batch finishes.

name: accelerator
label: Accelerator
help: GPU requires a Business or Enterprise plan and uses 3× credits. If no GPU is ready, the job runs on CPU at normal credits.
